hits.content: An association between polyalanine expansion length and severity of autonomic dysfunction has been proposed. A similar relationship is described between the genotype for polyalanine mutations and the need for continuous ventilatory dependence, although this is inconsistent. Later-onset cases usually have the 20/24 or 20/25 genotype with milder hypoventilation. However, this relationship is variable and a few remarkable exceptions are known at present.
